books.title: The Lightning Thief
books.synopsis: Percy Jackson is a 12-year-old boy with ADHD and dyslexia who was leading an ordinary life when he discovers that he is a demigod, the son of a Greek god and a mortal, and must go to Camp Half-Blood, a refuge for young demigods. There, Poseidon claims him as his son, and the gods accuse him of stealing Zeus’s master lightning bolt. Now he must travel across the United States to find the real thief and prevent a war among the gods, alongside the demigoddess Annabeth Chase — daughter of Athena — and his satyr friend Grover Underwood.
books.author: Rick Riordan

books.title: The Sea of Monsters
books.synopsis: Camp Half-Blood is in grave danger. The magical boundaries that protect the demigods’ only safe haven have been weakened because Thalia’s tree has been mysteriously poisoned. Furthermore, Percy Jackson discovers through terrifying dreams that his best friend, the satyr Grover Underwood, has been captured by the cyclops Polyphemus. To save his friend and the camp from total destruction by hordes of monsters, Percy, along with Annabeth and Tyson — his newly discovered cyclops half-brother — sets out in search of the Golden Fleece, located in the dangerous Sea of Monsters, in the Bermuda Triangle.
books.author: Rick Riordan

books.title: The Titan's Curse
books.synopsis: During a rescue mission to help Grover, who has discovered two powerful new demigods — Bianca and Nico di Angelo — a terrifying mythological monster attacks the group, and Annabeth is kidnapped. Meanwhile, the goddess Artemis sets out alone to hunt a legendary creature capable of destroying Olympus, but she, too, mysteriously disappears. With an official rescue mission organized at Camp Half-Blood, Percy, Grover, Thalia, and Artemis’s Huntresses set out together for Mount Tamalpais to save Artemis and Annabeth, destroy an ancient monster feared by the gods, and confront Luke and his “General.” Along the way, they must also face their most dangerous challenge yet: the chilling prophecy of the Titan’s curse.
books.author: Rick Riordan

books.title: The Battle of the Labyrinth
books.synopsis: Camp Half-Blood is at risk of being invaded from within by Luke's army through the Labyrinth of Daedalus — a magical structure that grows on its own underground — bypassing the camp's magical defenses and destroying it. Faced with this, to prevent the invasion, Annabeth Chase leads her first official mission and invites Percy, Grover, and Tyson to navigate the deadly tunnels of the labyrinth. Their goal is to find the brilliant inventor Daedalus, the creator of the Labyrinth, before Luke convinces him to help.
books.author: Rick Riordan

books.title: The Last Olympian
books.synopsis: Here comes the great moment: Cronos' army marches on New York and Mount Olympus is practically defenseless. It is up to Percy and the demigods of Camp Half-Blood to lead the final defense of the Greek gods in a battle that will determine the fulfillment of the Great Prophecy and the fate of the world.
books.author: Rick Riordan

books.title: The Lost Hero
books.synopsis: Following the conclusion of the Percy Jackson & the Olympians saga, we follow three new demigods: Jason Grace, who wakes up on a school bus with no memory of his past; Piper McLean, a young woman with the power to persuade people through her voice; and Leo Valdez, a hyperactive boy with an unusual affinity for mechanics and fire. After a surprise attack by storm spirits, the trio is taken to Camp Half-Blood, where they discover their divine heritage and are assigned an urgent mission: to rescue the goddess Hera, who has been kidnapped by a dark force linked to the awakening of the Titan Gaia. Throughout their journey, the group must race against time to prevent the giants from destroying the gods of Olympus, while Jason tries to piece together the fragments of his memories.
books.author: Rick Riordan

books.title: The Son of Neptune
books.synopsis: Percy wakes up with no memories in an unfamiliar world, clinging only to a vague recollection of the name Annabeth. Pursued by monsters that refuse to die, he arrives at Camp Jupiter, the secret home of the Roman demigods, where he is welcomed as a son of Neptune, the god of the sea. There, he befriends the outcasts Hazel Levesque and Frank Zhang, who harbor deep secrets about their own pasts. Together, the three are sent on a desperate mission to the lands beyond the gods, in Alaska, with the goal of freeing Thanatos, the god of death, defeating the giant Polybotes, and recovering the golden eagle of Rome. Percy must regain the trust of the Roman camp and save the new base before Gaia’s army destroys it, all while trying to piece together his former life.
books.author: Rick Riordan

books.title: The Mark of Athena
books.synopsis: When the flying ship Argo II docks at Camp Jupiter, the Greek demigods attempt to forge a peace alliance. However, the peaceful encounter is quickly ruined by a spiritual possession instigated by Gaia, turning the Romans into relentless enemies and forcing the seven demigods of the prophecy — Percy, Annabeth, Jason, Piper, Leo, Hazel, and Frank — to flee together. While the group sails toward the ancient lands of Rome and Greece to close the Gates of Death, Annabeth Chase embarks on a dangerous and secret solo mission: to follow the trail of the enigmatic Mark of Athena. She must confront her worst fears to recover the ancient statue of Athena Parthenos, the only relic capable of healing the millennia-old rivalry between the two camps, culminating in a confrontation that demands devastating sacrifices.
books.author: Rick Riordan

books.title: The House of Hades
books.synopsis: In the depths of Tartarus, the darkest place in the underworld, Percy and Annabeth face a grueling journey for survival, surrounded by monsters thirsting for revenge and relying on unlikely allies to reach the Gates of Death from the inside. Meanwhile, aboard the Argo II, the rest of the crew sails across the Mediterranean toward the Temple of Hades in Greece. They must overcome brutal trials imposed by gods and monsters to reach the outer side of the Gates and free their friends. The race against time requires each demigod to mature and make difficult decisions to seal the passage, preventing Gaia’s forces from advancing once and for all.
books.author: Rick Riordan

books.title: The Blood of Olympus
books.synopsis: As the final showdown with Mother Earth, Gaia, draws near, the seven demigods of the prophecy race against time aboard the Argo II toward the Acropolis in Athens. To fully awaken, Gaia needs the blood of just two demigods — one Greek and one Roman — and her army of giants is ready to capture them. Meanwhile, Reyna Ávila Ramírez-Arellano, Nico di Angelo, and Coach Hedge embark on a perilous journey through the skies to bring the statue of Athena Parthenos back to Camp Half-Blood in an attempt to prevent a bloody civil war against the Roman legions led by the mad Octavian. Uniting Greeks and Romans in a desperate battle on two fronts, the heroes must make ultimate sacrifices to save the gods, the mortal world, and ensure the survival of their homes.
books.author: Rick Riordan

books.title: The Hidden Oracle
books.synopsis: After enraging his father, Zeus, Apollo is punished and banished from Olympus, waking up in an alley in New York City in the body of Lester Papadopoulos — a clumsy, acne-ridden mortal teenager with none of his divine powers. To survive in a world full of monsters and ancient enemies seeking revenge, he teams up with Meg McCaffrey, a feisty, homeless demigoddess. Together, they seek refuge at Camp Half-Blood, where they discover that the world’s oracles are falling silent or disappearing. To reclaim his place on Mount Olympus, Apollo must find a way to free the Oracle of Delphi from an ancient Roman threat, while facing the greatest challenge of his immortality: learning to be human.
books.author: Rick Riordan

books.title: The Dark Prophecy
books.synopsis: Continuing the journey of punishment for the former god Apollo — trapped in the body of the mortal Lester Papadopoulos — he travels across the United States alongside Leo Valdez and the immortal nymph Calypso. The group arrives in Indianapolis, where they discover the Waystation, a sanctuary for demigods and regenerated monsters that serves as a base from which to confront the second member of the terrifying Roman Triumvirate: Emperor Commodus. To advance his quest for immortality, Apollo must free the next Mystic Oracle, who is being held captive by the emperor in a dangerous cave that drives people mad. Without his divine powers, the former god is forced to reconnect with old friends, confront traumas from his own past, and discover the true meaning of friendship and sacrifice before the Triumvirate destroys everything he loves.
books.author: Rick Riordan

books.title: The Burning Maze
books.synopsis: In the heart of the American Southwest, the former god Apollo and his young master Meg McCaffrey make their way through the ruins of Daedalus’s Labyrinth, which has been transformed into an underground hell. The extreme heat generated by the Labyrinth is causing devastating droughts and wildfires on the surface — a catastrophe orchestrated by the third and most cruel emperor of the Roman Triumvirate: Caligula. To halt this destruction and free the next Oracle, the Sibyl of Cumae, Apollo needs the help of the satyr Grover Underwood and the demigods Jason Grace and Piper McLean on what is considered the darkest and most painful journey of the saga.
books.author: Rick Riordan

books.title: The Tyrant's Tomb
books.synopsis: Following the tragic events of the previous book, Apollo and Meg travel to Camp Jupiter to seek help and deliver an urgent warning. The Roman demigods’ base is recovering from a near-fatal attack and preparing for an even worse invasion: the combined forces of Emperors Caligula and Commodus, who are now backed by a cruel ancient Roman king turned undead. To defend the camp and unravel a dark prophecy, Apollo must work alongside old friends like Hazel, Frank, and the praetor Reyna. The group must find the tyrant’s forgotten tomb and face an army of the undead, forcing Apollo to lead a desperate resistance where leadership, duty, and overcoming guilt will be tested to the limit.
books.author: Rick Riordan

books.title: The Tower of Nero
books.synopsis: In this grand conclusion to the journey of atonement for the former god Apollo and his mentor Meg McCaffrey, they finally return to where it all began: New York. To regain his immortality and save the world, Apollo must defeat the last and most powerful member of the Roman Triumvirate, Emperor Nero, who threatens to destroy the entire city with Greek fire if they do not bow to his power. He infiltrates the tyrant’s impenetrable tower with the help of Nico di Angelo, Will Solace, and an alliance of unlikely allies. Furthermore, the final confrontation requires him to descend into the depths to defeat his ancient archenemy, the serpent Python, who holds total control over the world’s fate, in a battle where the former god must prove whether he has learned the true essence of heroism and humanity.
books.author: Rick Riordan
